definitions.explanation: Loud, unpleasant, or unwanted sound that disturbs or annoys.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{騒音|そうおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
{騒音|そうおん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't sleep because of the noise.

examples.japanese: {騒音|そうおん}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}っている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Residents are complaining about the noise problem.

notes:
{騒音|そうおん} specifically refers to noise that is bothersome or disruptive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {騒音|そうおん}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (noise problem)
- {騒音|そうおん}⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧ (noise regulation)
- {騒音|そうおん}⟦{公害|こうがい}→公害：14944_kougai⟧ (noise pollution)
- ⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧{騒音|そうおん} (traffic noise)
- {騒音|そうおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to make noise)
